name: toggle-group
useFor: Use for switching a view (Map, List, Compare), a unit or a distance band, with two to five short options. Use type single for one choice and multiple for layers. For more options or long labels use Select or Radio Group. A row too wide for its container fades at the side (fade-x) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: A sliding or animated chosen item
Icons without labels unless each has an aria-label
source: Not in Figma; drawn from "UI · Buttons" (442:3) and the field frame (442:107)
title: Toggle group
description: A choice among a few: a segmented track in the field's frame (36px, Bone, 1px Stone line, the cut) whose chosen item is a Forest key with a Bone label. The outline variant is a row of framed toggles, joined with spacing 0.
